description: Memorial aircraft at Divulje beside the Knez Trpimir barracks; the OpenStreetMap surveyor transcribed the dedication — in memory of Colonel Ivica Ivandić who flew across from Ponikve airfield near Užice in Serbia to Split airport; it is NOT established that this is Ivandić's own aircraft; no serial recorded; the airframe was flown by the Yugoslav Air Force at the moment commemorated
